title: centunculus pentandrus var. elongatus
intro: Centunculus pentandrus var. elongatus, commonly known as Chrysanthemum tea, is a type of flowering plant used in traditional medicine. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and acting as an antioxidant to protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Centunculus pentandrus var. elongatus include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making it useful for treating anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
